facts.value: The course initialization passes grTNess_80222674 to Ground_InitTargetStage. That inline invokes the factory for IDs 0, 1 and 2 and ignores each return. For each ID, the local factory selects grTNs_StageCallbacks[id], calls Ground_GetStageGObj to construct a new stage GObj, applies the selected callbacks only on success, reports a NULL constructor result, and returns that result. Ground_GetStageGObj allocates and initializes selected Ground fields, installs model/process state and registers the object; it is not an existing-object lookup.
facts.rationale: Correct existing-object lookup language to construction, preserving the wrapper contract and independent limitations.
